sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Galehodin was an Arthurian hero. He was the only brother of Lancelot. He otherwise stays obscure in the record. Several figures around Lancelot carry similar names. These include Galahad and Galahaut. The names may all come from a single original.
